bio.text: Josh Tanner is a Republican who represents District 14 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term; the directory lists Tanner as a business owner.
According to the legislature's biography, Tanner was raised in the Treasure Valley and holds an Executive MBA and a Bachelor of Science from Boise State University.
It says Tanner is an elected Eagle fire commissioner who has served as chairman since 2018 and operates three Eagle-based businesses.
